summary: Iteration 4 — Guest-mode + optional-signup + country-quiz-retry regression. Backend: 26/26 pytest passed in 7.84s. Frontend: All 11 guest & auth flows verified end-to-end on preview URL. Guest can play /quiz /explorer /save-smart /leaderboard with ZERO /api/quiz/submit calls; /dashboard and /admin redirect guests to /login as designed. Country-quiz 'Take again' now jumps STRAIGHT into active phase (cq-num visible=True, country-quiz-start visible=False after retry click) — key fix verified. Optional-signup blue banner ('Signing up is optional' + 'we can keep track of your progress') present on /register with working register-skip → /quiz and register-back-home → /. Login page has login-guest link. Sidebar nav-home + brand-home present. Admin regression: sign-in with admin@taxmaster.pro/Admin@123 shows My Dashboard + Admin Panel; /api/quiz/submit correctly fires on answer and score API returns updated user (verified via /auth/me — total_score unchanged only because the automated pick was the incorrect option, which correctly returns 0 delta; pytest test_submit_quiz_updates_stats_and_achievements already proves +10 per correct answer works).
critical_code_review_comments: Visiting /dashboard or /admin as guest triggers a 401 on /api/auth/me before ProtectedRoute redirects — harmless (expected auth probe) but shows up as 'Failed to load resource: 401' in console. Consider silencing 401 on /auth/me in api.js interceptor (or handling as anonymous state) to keep the console clean for guests.

WorldExplorer CountryView finalize(score) is called from next() after the last question. Because the score state update happens between the pick click and the Next click, React has already re-rendered and score is the correct final value — no off-by-one. However this depends on user always clicking Next after the last answer; consider passing `score + (i === q.correct ? 1 : 0)` directly from pick to remove the two-click dependency entirely.

IndianQuiz submitProgress sends 1 request per question (score:1/total:1). This is functionally correct and matches leaderboard expectations, but is chatty. If backend load ever becomes a concern, batch submits (e.g., every 5 questions or on session end).

Landing.jsx auto-redirects authed users to /dashboard via useEffect. If an authed user actually WANTS to visit '/', they cannot — consider adding an explicit escape (e.g., dashboard header 'Public site' link) or dropping the auto-redirect and just showing a dashboard shortcut in the header.
Sidebar 'Playing as guest' CTA copy is clear; recommend the same guest banner style on /explorer /save-smart /leaderboard for consistency (currently only /quiz has the top blue banner).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested guest + auth flows verified

test_credentials: Admin admin@taxmaster.pro / Admin@123 (from /app/backend/.env). Guest flows require no credentials.
seed_data_creation: 48 countries + admin auto-seeded on startup. No test data pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public routes (guest-accessible, no ProtectedRoute): /quiz /explorer /save-smart /leaderboard. Auth-only routes: /dashboard, /admin. IndianQuiz.jsx and WorldExplorer.jsx CountryView both gate /api/quiz/submit with `if (!user || user === false) return;` so no 401s fire for guests. Country quiz has only 3 questions per country. Retry: cq-retry testid → phase='active' (skips intro). Testids on Register: register-back-home, register-skip. Login: login-guest. Landing: landing-guest-btn, landing-signin-btn, landing-signup-btn, hero-cta-guest, hero-cta-secondary. Sidebar: nav-home, brand-home, nav-quiz, nav-explorer, nav-savesmart, nav-leaderboard, nav-dashboard (auth-only), nav-admin (admin-only), sidebar-login-btn, sidebar-signup-btn, logout-btn. Backend endpoint /api/quiz/submit still requires auth (401 for guests) — that's why submit must be client-side gated for guests.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no regressions found. The 'countries quiz retry' bug reported by user is fixed: retry() in WorldExplorer.jsx line 133 now sets setPhase('active') directly instead of returning to 'intro'. Verified in browser: after clicking cq-retry, cq-num (Q1/N badge) is immediately visible and country-quiz-start button is NOT visible.
